item.author: George Orwell
item.description: Winston Smith altera documentos para un Partido que vigila incluso los pensamientos. Su relación con Julia y su deseo de conocer la verdad lo enfrentan a un régimen que pretende controlar la memoria, el lenguaje y la intimidad.

en.description: Winston Smith rewrites records for a Party that polices even people's thoughts. His relationship with Julia and his search for truth bring him into conflict with a regime determined to control memory, language and private life.
en.title: Nineteen Eighty-Four
